description: Phase 7: Notifications. Implement Notification model with signals for application status changes and new applicants. Create email templates for all status change notifications using Django templates. Build JobAlert model for job seekers to subscribe to category/keyword alerts. Create management commands send_job_alerts (matches new jobs to alerts, sends emails) and expire_jobs (marks jobs past deadline as expired).
steps: 1. Create Notification model in notifications/models.py with FK to User recipient, notification_type CharField choices (APPLICATION_SUBMITTED, APPLICATION_STATUS_CHANGED, NEW_APPLICANT, JOB_ALERT, INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED), title CharField, message TextField, related_object_type CharField, related_object_id PositiveIntegerField, is_read BooleanField default False, created_at. Add indexes on recipient, is_read, created_at.

2. Create JobAlert model in notifications/models.py with FK to User, FK to Category nullable, keywords TextField (comma-separated), location CharField, job_type CharField, is_active BooleanField, created_at, last_sent_at nullable. Add index on is_active.

3. Create notifications/signals.py with Django signals: application_submitted (sends notification to job owner/company employees and email), application_status_changed (sends notification to applicant and email), interview_scheduled (sends notification to applicant and email)
4. Connect signals in notifications/apps.py ready() method

5. Create email templates in templates/notifications/emails/: application_submitted_email.html (to recruiter), application_status_changed_email.html (to applicant with status), interview_scheduled_email.html (to applicant with details), job_alert_email.html (to job seeker with matched jobs)

6. Create notifications/services.py with NotificationService class: send_notification(user, notification_type, title, message, related_object), send_email_notification(user, template_name, context), mark_as_read(notification_id), mark_all_as_read(user), get_unread_count(user)
7. Update applications/services.py to trigger signals when creating application, changing status, scheduling interview
8. Create JobAlertForm in notifications/forms.py with category, keywords, location, job_type fields, Bootstrap styling

9. Create views in notifications/views.py: NotificationListView (user's notifications), MarkNotificationReadView (mark single as read), MarkAllReadView (mark all as read), JobAlertListView (user's job alerts), JobAlertCreateView, JobAlertUpdateView, JobAlertDeleteView, JobAlertToggleView (activate/deactivate alert)

10. Create management command notifications/management/commands/send_job_alerts.py: query active JobAlerts, find jobs posted since last_sent_at (or last 24h if null) matching category/keywords/location/job_type, group by user, send email with matched jobs list, update last_sent_at
11. Create management command jobs/management/commands/expire_jobs.py: query active jobs where deadline < today, set is_active=False, send notification to job owner

12. Create URL patterns in notifications/urls.py with app_name='notifications': '', '<int:pk>/read/', 'mark-all-read/', 'job-alerts/', 'job-alerts/create/', 'job-alerts/<int:pk>/edit/', 'job-alerts/<int:pk>/delete/', 'job-alerts/<int:pk>/toggle/'
13. Update config/urls.py to include notifications.urls at 'notifications/' prefix

14. Create templates: notifications_list.html (list with unread badge, mark as read button, link to related object), job_alert_list.html (list with active/inactive toggle, edit/delete actions), job_alert_form.html (crispy form)
15. Update base.html navbar to show notification bell icon with unread count badge (use context processor or template tag)
16. Create notifications/context_processors.py with unread_notifications_count function
17. Add context processor to settings TEMPLATES OPTIONS context_processors
18. Add notification dropdown in navbar showing recent 5 notifications with 'View All' link
19. Run makemigrations for notifications models
20. Run migrate
21. Write tests for signal triggering, email sending, job alert matching logic, expire_jobs command
acceptance_criteria: Notification model stores in-app notifications with type, title, message, related object reference
When job seeker applies, notification and email sent to job's company owner and employees
When application status changes, notification and email sent to applicant with new status
When interview scheduled, notification and email sent to applicant with date/time/location
Email templates use Django template engine with proper styling and context
JobAlert model allows job seekers to create alerts with category, keywords, location, job_type filters
Management command send_job_alerts matches new jobs to active alerts and sends emails (cron-ready)
Management command expire_jobs marks jobs past deadline as inactive (cron-ready)
Notifications page shows all notifications with unread badge, mark as read button
Navbar bell icon shows unread count, dropdown shows recent 5 notifications
Job alerts page shows user's alerts with activate/deactivate toggle, edit/delete actions
All email notifications sent via Django email backend configured in settings
Tests verify signal triggering, email content, and job alert matching
